description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the South Carolina Code of Laws — South Carolina state statutes — by citation. "S.C. Code 16-3-10" is murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does South Carolina Code 16-3-10 say" or to check an SC statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "16-3-10" (murder) or "56-5-2930" (DUI). Title-chapter-section.

name: sc_code_section
